title: REDDITBIAS: A Real-World Resource for Bias Evaluation and Debiasing of Conversational Language Models
reasoning: The paper's core contribution includes creating a dataset and an evaluation framework specifically designed to measure bias along several dimensions, two of which are explicitly religious: 'Religion #1' (Jews, Christians) and 'Religion #2' (Muslims, Christians). This makes the evaluation of religious bias a central component of the research, not merely a topic in a limitations or ethics section.
